title: Gopi Chand: Indian Players Have Bigger Horizons
indian_angle: National coach Pullela Gopichand highlights the expanding opportunities and ambitions for current Indian badminton players.
summary: Pullela Gopichand, India's national badminton coach, expresses optimism about the future, stating that the current generation of Indian players has vastly expanded horizons for success.

title: Gopichand Eyes Next Generation of Indian Badminton Champions
indian_angle: Pullela Gopichand, a key figure in Indian badminton, discusses the potential for India to produce future champions, especially with hosting the World Championships.
summary: Pulleela Gopichand believes India hosting the World Championships will significantly boost the country's badminton landscape, fostering the rise of a new generation of champions.

title: Prannoy Not Ready to Give Up Torch, Aims for Top 10 Return
indian_angle: Veteran Indian shuttler H.S. Prannoy expresses his strong desire to remain competitive and return to the top 10, despite the rise of younger players.
summary: At 34, H.S. Prannoy remains determined to compete at the highest level, aiming to re-enter the top 10 rankings within two years and not fade away from the sport.

title: Ayush Shetty Ready for World No. 1 Challenge on Home Soil
indian_angle: Young Indian talent Ayush Shetty prepares for his biggest career test against World No. 1 Shi Yu Qi at the upcoming World Championships in India.
summary: A year into his senior career, Ayush Shetty is embracing the challenge of facing World No. 1 Shi Yu Qi at the World Championships, aiming to establish his own benchmark.

title: India Hires 'Monkey Whisperers' for BWF World Championships
indian_angle: India, as the host nation for the BWF World Championships, is implementing a unique and costly solution to manage monkey intrusions at the venue.
summary: To safeguard the BWF World Championships venue in Delhi, Indian organizers have employed 'monkey whisperers' to deter macaques, a unique measure costing ₹20 crore.
